{{Quote|Just give me a decent fight for once, will ya?|Ironfist|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Ironfist''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He has never been captured, defeated, or even driven back. He and his men were hired by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]] to [[Assault on the Esseles|capture]] the bridge of [[Unidentified Republic transport|Republic transport]] the [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']] so that Kilran could gain custody of Ambassador [[Vyn Asara]], whom the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] classed a terrorist. While an Imperial boarding party distracted a group of Republic defenders, Ironfist's Mandalorian forces [[Assault on the Esseles|seized]] the bridge of the ''Esseles''. Upon realizing their mistake, the defenders stormed the bridge and freed the command crew, killing Ironfist in the process and his Mandalorian allies.
